const obj = {};

data.split('\n').forEach(line => {
  const [key, HRA,DA,TA,NPS] = line.split(',');
  obj[key] = {"HRA":HRA,"DA":DA,"TA":TA,"NPS":NPS};
});

const keys = Object.keys(obj);
let i = 0;
function selectOptionByPartialText(partialText) {
  var select = document.getElementById('ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder1_ddlemployee');
  console.log("select---->",select)
  for (var i = 0; i < select.options.length; i++) {
    if (select.options[i].text.includes(partialText)) {
      select.selectedIndex = i;
      break;
    }
  }
}
function deselectSelectedOption() {
  var select = document.getElementById('ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder1_ddlemployee');
  $("ContentPlaceHolder1_ddlDDo").find("option[selected]").removeAttr("selected");
  select.selectedIndex = -1; // Deselect the selected option
}

function sleep(ms) {
  return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}
  const waitForIdle = async () => {
      while ($("#ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder1_UpdateProgress1").css("display") !== "none") {
